functions.name: analyze_image
functions.description: Analyzes an image or screenshot and provides detailed visual information including text content, UI elements, and state information.

image_path.description: Path to the image file to analyze (absolute or relative path)

focus_areas.description: Optional list of areas to focus analysis on (e.g., ['text', 'buttons', 'errors'])

functions.name: execute_command
functions.description: Executes a system command or action through the Jarvis executor with specified parameters.

tool_name.description: Name of the registered tool to execute (e.g., 'read', 'write', 'api_call')

params.description: Parameters to pass to the tool

functions.name: get_metrics
functions.description: Retrieves system metrics, performance data, and health information about Jarvis.

functions.name: apply_improvement
functions.description: Applies a learned improvement or optimization to the system configuration or execution strategy.

target.description: Component or system area to apply improvement to

functions.name: check_health
functions.description: Performs comprehensive health check on all system components and returns status report.

detailed.description: Whether to return detailed diagnostic information
